comment: The json-patch-tests suite, byte for byte at the pinned commit under app/specs/oracle/json-patch-tests: the validation oracle for RFC 6902 JSON Patch (with RFC 6901 JSON Pointer). Each case gives a document, a patch, and the expected result or that it must fail. generators/snapshot's jsonpatchoracle applies every case, the disabled ones too, and refuses when any differs (GN-01).
standard: RFC 6902 JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Patch, IETF; RFC 6901 JSON Pointer
